name: CP-6 Refraction Probe
description: The CP-6 Refraction Probe was a model of small probe droid used by the Chiss spy Maki'voro, a lieutenant of the spymaster known as the Shroud during the Galactic War. One of a number of probe models that Maki'voro used, the CP-6 was designed to hover near Maki'voro and deflect enemy attacks.
